title: A guide pointing at the Library rings a shelf with its tiles cut off
goal: When a tutorial points at the Library, the shelf is usually the last thing in a tall panel, so the ring lands half off the bottom of the window and the tile the guide is talking about is cut in two. Somebody following the guide has to scroll to see the thing they were just shown.
notes:
Reproduced on the probe on 2026-09-13 while building the Colours and Styles track.

  Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/tutorial-save-a-colour-as-a-style-walk.json --no-build

Then look at /tmp/photonz-playtest/tutorial-save-a-colour-as-a-style-walk/3-on-the-shelf-sc.png: the ring is round the Library section, the Styles shelf is showing, and the Brand tile that just landed is cut in half by the bottom edge of the window. Same in tutorial-the-library-walk 3-a-tile-is-a-handle-sc.png.

Why it happens: TutorialController asks for .revealTarget, which scrolls until TutorialAnchorView.isWhollyShown, and the Library section is taller than the room left under the sections above it, so the reveal can never be satisfied and stops after its fixed number of tries wherever it got to. Options worth weighing: reveal to the section HEADER plus one tile row rather than the whole section; or let a step name how much of its target it needs.
acceptance: A guide step that points at the Library shows the whole shelf, or as much of it as the window can hold, without the person scrolling
The three tutorial walks that ring the shelf show a whole row of tiles in their screenshots
Nothing else in the panel is scrolled somewhere unhelpful to achieve it: the row a drag starts from stays on screen too

log.note: Reproduced from the 02:31 sweep (screen was unlocked then; it is locked now). The task's stated cause is WRONG: the reveal is not failing and the ring is not half off the window. In tutorial-save-a-colour-as-a-style the dock reads dockViewport 621, dockSections ['Layers -67-96','Appearance 96-327','Effects 327-395','Motion 395-476','Library 476-621'] - the Library section is entirely inside the dock. What is cut is its BODY: dockListRoom says 'Library 112/157', i.e. the height budget squeezed it to DockMetrics.listFloor (112) when it wants 157. The body scroller then cuts through the tile row, and what it cuts away is the caption UNDER the picture, which is the tile's name. The guide says 'the Brand tile that just landed' and you cannot read the word Brand. Same in five more walks: the-library 112/305, make-a-component 112/233, text-styles 112/157, use-it-again-and-again 112/233, change-it-everywhere 112/157.
